1.web: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
1.asv: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!

2.web: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard; that came down on the edge of his robes;
2.asv: It is like the precious oil upon the head, That ran down upon the beard, Even Aaron’s beard; That came down upon the skirt of his garments;

3.web: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion: for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forever more.
3.asv: Like the dew of Hermon, That cometh down upon the mountains of Zion: For there Jehovah commanded the blessing, Even life for evermore.
